### TAG-220: `value_transform.collectValueTransformRules` produces token-input rules for bare-source-header definitions

**Status:** ⬜ Not started

## Software Notes

Repro: `4BITADD` invoking `FULLADD` ([TAG-211](https://linear.app/taguniversal/issue/TAG-211/example-1218-bundling-digits-into-numbers)). `checkInvocable(FULLADD) failed on name='S'` — `S` is a token on `A`, not a place. The rules should have `inputs=[A,B,CI]` and select entries keyed by `S,U,W` etc., the same shape the new `appendSelectRules` path produces for `INNER`. `collectValueTransformRules` needs to recognize the `$A $B $CI :` header form and produce select rules keyed by the composed token tuple.

## Reference

```
// Linear TAG-211 Example 12.18 Bundling digits into numbers
4BITADD($A $B $CARRYIN)(SUM<> CARRYOUT<>)
4BITADD[([A0<> A1<> A2<> A3<>] [B0<> B1<> B2<> B3<>] CI<>)
  ([$SUM0 $SUM1 $SUM2 $SUM3] $CO)

  FULLADD(A0<> B0<> CI<>)(SUM0<> C1<>)
  FULLADD(A1<> B1<> C1<>)(SUM1<> C2<>)
  FULLADD(A2<> B2<> C2<>)(SUM2<> C3<>)
  FULLADD(A3<> B3<> C3<>)(SUM3<> $CO)
  :
]

FULLADD[(A< > B< > CI< >)($SUM $CO)
  $A $B $CI :
K[SUM<K>] L[SUM<L>] M[CO<M>] N[CO<N>]
S,U,W[K,M] S,U,X[L,M] S,V,W[L,M] S,V,X[K,N]
T,U,W[L,M] T,U,X[K,N] T,V,W[K,N] T,V,X[L,N] 
]
```
